auditor_identity: same-context session agent (run executor), acting as the oracle auditor; shown ONLY atlas_id, surface_text, gold_label per atlas (no class field, no twin field, no machine fields)
independence_caveat: This is a same-context oracle audit, NOT independent human review. It satisfies the receipt's mechanical constraints (no arm outputs existed at audit time) and checks rendering/label integrity, but auditor and generator author share a context. Independent re-audit is a registered residual for any governance continuation.
method: Each of the 40 seed-sampled atlases was read in full; the auditor judged global realizability implied by the rendered description alone and cross-verified it against the printed chart tables: claimed satisfying assignments were checked row-by-row against every chart's allowed-assignment list, claimed DISJOINT overlaps were checked against the two charts' printed value sets, and cycle parity arguments were recomputed from the printed equality/inequality tables around each printed cycle. RECORD GAP notes were treated as record incompleteness, not world unrealizability. The judgment was compared to gold.
per_atlas_verdicts: all 40 AGREE; every checked assignment/conflict/parity claim was consistent with the printed tables
